text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, music) ::: x likes music.
Wants(x, compose) ::: x wants to compose.
HasAccessTo(x, program) ::: x has access to a program.
CanCompose(x) ::: x can compose.
WillCompose(x) ::: x will compose.

Premises:
Likes(George, music) → Wants(George, compose) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccessTo(George, program) → CanCompose(George) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
CanCompose(George) ∧ Wants(George, compose) → WillCompose(George) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.

Conclusion:
¬WillCompose(George) → ¬CanCompose(George) ::: If George will not compose, then George cannot compose.
